scope: Current source inspection; no live timing measurement or execution
observed: Frontier builder requires environment sequence and monotonic origin/elapsed clocks.
Perception normalization preserves game_tick and snapshot observation_revision.
Outer broker observation_revision is assigned from Date.getTime().
Player clock snapshot publishes a clock_id, client tick_index, world_tick_index and audit observed_at but no monotonic elapsed value.
Prior probe evidence reader checks exact request/turn/room/capability, active binding, provenance and age; its result does not establish a mapping to the current player execution clock.
implementation_consequence: Persist plane-labeled perception identity for the frontier and bind resident delivery separately to the current action clock. Implement explicit clock-domain measurements rather than equating world ticks, client ticks, workflow-relative elapsed time and audit revisions.
